name: craft
description: /craft:atdd runs the 7-step flow. /craft:craft turns a big or multi-step request into a linear activity (a markdown in .claude/local/activities, one verified item at a time, held by the activity-gate Stop hook) and enforces the root rule (less code is better than more code) and triages SOLID, KISS, YAGNI, DRY and Clean Code, reading only the reference of each principle with a signal. /craft:audit audits the whole repo. /craft:setup prepares lint with limits. /craft:hook turns a correction into a project hook. /craft:grill interviews the user in rounds of options until no decision is inferred, and writes the spec to .claude/local/grill. Hooks inject short rules in every session (ASD-STE100 writing, project memory, Claude as the tool of the user, research before facts and implementations, and the rule for each code change), deny English-less code, missing data-testid, skipped tests, E2E outside a container, unfiltered tests in a large suite and memory outside the project, and run the full suite before a push only when the project has tests, no CI and a code change that is not green.
